package.name: px4_offboard_bridge
package.description: Bridges the PX4-agnostic mpc_controller_node to a PX4 autopilot over uXRCE-DDS: converts world/ENU velocity ControlCommands to PX4 NED offboard setpoints, runs the offboard-engage + arm state machine, republishes PX4 odometry as ROS Odometry, and forwards the gimbal angle. All ENU/FLU<->NED/FRD frame conversion is isolated in this package.
